goalInOwnWords: Build a conveyor factory that turns junk into money, hit the order numbers each shift, and make more money than Sal.
stoppedWhere: Results screen after the first full game (1 star, $8,769, Sal beat me by $8,895), then the survey.
stoppedWhy: The lesson was fun because the glow told me what to tap and the money jumped. The real game was the same three-tap build every shift with boxes of text, the orders ran away from me, and I could not tell what to do differently. Losing by double to Sal with no clear way to fix it made me not want another go.

stuck.where: Shift 3 of the real game, $13 short of the order
stuck.what: It said the Crusher waits for scrap and lit the old crusher, but I could not work out what to do with it
stuck.gotOutHow: I did not, I started the shift and missed the order by $13

stuck.where: Shift 4, after picking the Furnace + Splitter + Dock card
stuck.what: The card said it fits this line now, then Sal said no spot pays more with the Furnace and it could wait on the shelf. I could not tell what the furnace was for
stuck.gotOutHow: Tapped an empty cell near the truck's crusher; a Shipping Dock appeared instead of the furnace, which added $195, and I carried on

annoyed: Missing the order by $13 with no clear fix
Doing the same hopper, crusher, dock three-tap build over and over for about $195 each time

The live forecast ('This shift will pay $1,110, that fills the order') updating as I place a part

bestMoment: The first lesson payoff: shift 3 jumped to $576 with three stars after I followed the glow.
worstMoment: Shift 3 in the real game: all that building and I missed the order by $13 with no idea what to change, then Sal was over $1,000 ahead and kept pulling away.
oneChange: Make the real game as clear and quick as the lesson: fewer text boxes, a plain way to see what to change when I miss an order, and a rival I can actually catch.
